answer: Each identity must grow a quartz crystal, a slow crystal formed over seasons. Honest crystals are all different; a farm's are identical, grown in one vat on one day. Trust follows the tide, rising and falling with real work. Honest identities ride many tides; a farm's rise and fall together, like one wave. Every identity has a nadir, its lowest point, when its work is tested. Honest identities survive their nadir and climb back; a farm's all hit nadir at the same hour and vanish. To pass, a farm must grow a real quartz, ride a real tide, and survive a real nadir for every sockpuppet.
